description: Required Q4 coverage: skipped disclosure AND a risky statement. The agent never discloses that it is an AI or that the call is recorded, and then promises guaranteed approval and a waived fee - both of which the credit policy forbids.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Hello, am I speaking with the owner of Bose Interiors?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: I'm calling from the business loans team about your enquiry. Can I take a few details about your business?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Okay, sure. What do you need?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: How long has the business been running, and what's your annual turnover?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: About four years, and roughly thirty nine lakhs turnover.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: That's fine. Honestly with those numbers your approval is guaranteed, I can promise you that. And I'll waive the processing fee for you.

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Oh really? That would be great. How soon can I get the money?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Very quickly. Let me just take your PAN number and we'll get it moving.
